dialogues.speaker: Iaune
dialogues.text: One moment. What does that shop sell? That is an eye-catching sign if I've ever seen one.

dialogues.speaker: Roialte
dialogues.text: Indeed, one could say the same of every one of this tribe's shop signboards. Striking in the extreme.

dialogues.speaker: Roialte
dialogues.text: The Kamera Club would have a field day here.
